concerns.text: Phase 6 (T051-T054) is scheduled to run after US2 (Analysis) but is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) in T051. T051 requires 'top 5 microbial taxa from US2 results' as input. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it depends on the output of a preceding user story. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule. T051 must be sequential to US2 completion.

Task T048 ('Run quickstart.md validation') is marked [X] (complete) but depends on T049 ('Generate quickstart.md'). The dependency section explicitly states 'Requires T049 first'. T048 cannot be executed before T049 generates the artifact. This is a direct consumer-before-producer violation.

Task T002c ('Install requirements') is marked [S] (sequential) and correctly notes 'Depends on T002b'. However, T002a ('Create requirements.txt') is marked [P] (parallel). T002c reads the file created by T002a. If T002a and T002c run in parallel (as [P] implies for the phase), T002c may fail if T002a hasn't finished writing the file. T002a should be sequential or T002c must explicitly wait for T002a completion, breaking the [P] assumption for the group.

Task T011b ('verify presence of diet type') is listed as a separate task from T011 (download/parse). T011b depends on the data being downloaded by T011. While they are in the same file, listing them as separate [P] tasks implies they can run in parallel. T011b cannot run until T011 completes. They should be merged or T011b should be marked sequential to T011.
